name: io.github.P2Flux/mcp
description: Let your AI assistant pay for web content in USDC (x402) within a budget you set.

tools.name: find_paid_content
tools.description: Search the P2Flux directory for websites that sell content to AI agents. Returns site names, what they offer and the price per page. Costs nothing.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "soup recipes". Empty lists the newest sites.

tools.name: check_price
tools.description: See what a web page costs for an AI agent, without paying.

access_tokens.description: Access tokens exactly as get_paid_page gave them (host|token|seal). Each is sent only to the site it was given for; others are ignored.

tools.name: request_paid_page
tools.description: Ask to read a paid web page. Returns a link the USER must open to approve the payment in their own wallet - show the link and the price to the user and wait. Then call get_paid_page with the request_id. Nothing is paid without the user approving it.

max_price.description: The most to pay for this page, in USDC, e.g. "0.10". Required, after asking the user, for anything above a few USDC (a subscription).

access_tokens.description: Access tokens exactly as get_paid_page gave them (host|token|seal). Each is sent only to the site it was given for; others are ignored.

tools.name: get_paid_page
tools.description: Get the text of a page after the user approved its payment (see request_paid_page).

claim.description: The claim from request_paid_page (not on the approval link).
